description: Granting no-pay leave to officers entitled to political rights who contested at the Local Government Elections and elected as Deputy Mayors/Vice Chairmen of such institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the provisions of Public Administration Circular 12/2021 dated 2021 06 25, officers entitled to political rights who contested at the Local Government Elections and elected as Deputy Mayors/Vice Chairmen of such institutions are able to obtain 06 days leave with pay per month. However, if the said leave period is not adequate to attend the meetings of the relevant Local Government Authority and engage in related activities, it has been recommended in a discussion held under the chairmanship of the Director General of Establishments and with the participation of representatives of the relevant institutions that it would be appropriate to provide such officers with the opportunity to take no-pay leave. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to issue Circular instructions amending the provisions of the Establishments Code, enabling the officers entitled to political rights who contested at the Local Government Elections and elected as Deputy Mayors/Vice Chairmen of such institutions to obtain no-pay leave, was approved by the Cabinet.
